meta.title: fix: security, performance, and reliability issues in API
meta.body_summary: Fixes three critical bugs: insecure cookie parsing, GlobalScope memory leaks, and potential infinite loops in API pagination.

perf_labels.notes: Maintainer self-merged a small Kotlin agent PR addressing coroutine scope and loop issues with no review or performance evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 368 changed lines, this is a small edit by absolute volume, but over 80% of that is a docs file later deleted; real changes are only ~62 lines across four source files. This fits a tiny, low-risk performance fix that was merged by the maintainer without review.

review_details.performance_claim: Fix GlobalScope memory leaks and potential infinite loops in API pagination to improve performance.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Coroutine scope replacement and loop guard addition are within standard Kotlin/Android fix territory; the PR was merged by the same maintainer without external review, suggesting low friction for small-scope technical fixes.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No performance evidence, benchmarks, or reproduction steps in the PR; only a short body description of the issues.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regressions or review issues were raised; the PR was merged directly.

core_change_summary.description: Replaced GlobalScope.launch with lifecycle-aware coroutine scopes in App.kt, added pagination loop safeguards in YouTube.kt, and fixed cookie parsing in Utils.kt; LoginScreen.kt received a minor coroutine adjustment. A BUGS_FIXED_REPORT.md was added then deleted.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The report file was added in the initial commit (153 lines) and then deleted in the second commit.
change_trajectory: Single commit introduces all performance, security, and reliability fixes across four source files plus a documentation report.
Second commit removes the documentation report.
PR merged by maintainer with no review interaction.

collaboration_trajectory: Cursor agent pushed a single comprehensive commit with fixes and a report file.
Maintainer deleted the report file in a second commit.
PR was merged by the same maintainer approximately 19.5 hours after creation, with no external review.
